narr: Thunderstorms formed along a cold front over south Texas on the 5th. Thunderstorms with locally heavy rainfall produced flooding in Laredo during the afternoon.
ev: Trained spotter reported Manadas Creek overflowed into Finley Elementary School's parking lot and intersecting roads on the northwest side of Laredo.
Public reported flooding of roads on the north side of Laredo.
